title: Meal Planning on a Changing Schedule
instructions: 这是一份为A2水平学习者设计的原创听力与语法练习，主题是“饮食与日常选择：在变化的日程中安排三餐”。请先听或读对话，完成8道听力理解题；然后学习much/many/a little/a few和should/should not的用法，并完成8道语法题；最后进行口语和写作迁移练习。所有题目均为模拟教学材料，不是官方雅思测试。
transcript:
Mia: Hi, Ben. Are you free for dinner on Friday?
Ben: I’m not sure. I have a late meeting. I should check my calendar.
Mia: OK. I want to cook at home. I have a lot of vegetables, but I don’t have many eggs.
Ben: How many eggs do you need?
Mia: Just a few. Maybe three or four. And I have a little rice, but not much.
Ben: I can bring some eggs. Should I bring anything else?
Mia: Yes, please. We need a few tomatoes. And maybe a little cheese.
Ben: No problem. I have many tomatoes at home. I can bring five.
Mia: Great. But don’t bring too many. We only need a few.
Ben: OK. What time should I come?
Mia: Come at seven. But I have a yoga class at six. I should finish at six forty-five.
Ben: So I should arrive at seven. Should I wait if you are late?
Mia: No, don’t wait outside. You can come in. The door is open.
Ben: Fine. And what should we cook?
Mia: We can make a simple rice dish with eggs and tomatoes. We shouldn’t use too much oil.
Ben: Good idea. I should not eat too much rice, but a little is fine.
Mia: Me too. We should eat more vegetables. I have many carrots and a few onions.
Ben: Perfect. See you on Friday at seven.
Mia: See you. Don’t forget the eggs!

questions.prompt: What does Mia want to do on Friday?
questions.explanation: Mia说“I want to cook at home.”，所以她想在家做饭。
questions.evidence: I want to cook at home.

questions.prompt: How many eggs does Mia need?
questions.explanation: Mia说“Just a few. Maybe three or four.”，她只需要几个鸡蛋。
questions.evidence: Just a few. Maybe three or four.

questions.prompt: What does Ben offer to bring?
questions.explanation: Ben说“I can bring some eggs.”，他主动提出带鸡蛋。

questions.prompt: How many tomatoes does Ben say he has at home?
questions.explanation: Ben说“I have many tomatoes at home.”，他家里有很多西红柿；后文“I can bring five”是说他可以带五个，不是说他家里只有五个。
questions.evidence: I have many tomatoes at home. I can bring five.

questions.explanation: Mia说“Come at seven.”，Ben也确认“So I should arrive at seven.”。

questions.prompt: What should they not use too much of?
questions.explanation: Mia说“We shouldn’t use too much oil.”，他们不应该用太多油。
questions.evidence: We shouldn’t use too much oil.

questions.prompt: What vegetables does Mia have many of?
questions.explanation: Mia说“I have many carrots and a few onions.”，她有很多胡萝卜。
questions.evidence: I have many carrots and a few onions.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence with one word from the conversation: Ben says he should not eat too ______ rice.
questions.explanation: Ben说“I should not eat too much rice.”，所以填much。
questions.evidence: I should not eat too much rice

vocabulary.example: I have a lot of vegetables, but I don’t have many eggs.
I have a little rice, but not much.
We shouldn’t use too much oil.
I have many carrots and a few onions.

grammar.title: much / many / a little / a few；should / should not
grammar.explanation: much 和 a little 用于不可数名词（如 rice, oil, cheese）；many 和 a few 用于可数名词复数（如 eggs, tomatoes, carrots）。much 和 many 常用于否定句和疑问句；a little 和 a few 表示“少量”。should 表示“应该”，should not (shouldn’t) 表示“不应该”，后面都接动词原形。
grammar.example: I have a little rice, but not much. / I have many carrots and a few onions. / We shouldn’t use too much oil.

questions.prompt: I have ______ apples in my bag. (a few / a little)
questions.explanation: apples 是可数名词复数，用 a few。
questions.evidence: I have a few apples in my bag.

questions.prompt: There isn’t ______ milk in the fridge. (many / much)
questions.explanation: milk 是不可数名词，否定句中用 much。
questions.evidence: There isn’t much milk in the fridge.

questions.prompt: She has ______ money, so she can buy a small gift. (a little / a few)
questions.explanation: money 是不可数名词，用 a little。
questions.evidence: She has a little money, so she can buy a small gift.

questions.prompt: How ______ students are in the classroom? (much / many)
questions.explanation: students 是可数名词复数，疑问句中用 many。
questions.evidence: How many students are in the classroom?

questions.prompt: You ______ drink more water. (should / should not)
He ______ eat too much sugar. (should / should not)
questions.explanation: 不建议吃太多糖，用 should not。
questions.evidence: He should not eat too much sugar.

questions.prompt: We have ______ time before the movie starts. (a little / a few)
questions.explanation: time 是不可数名词，用 a little。
questions.evidence: We have a little time before the movie starts.

questions.prompt: There are ______ chairs in the room. (a few / a little)
questions.explanation: chairs 是可数名词复数，用 a few。
questions.evidence: There are a few chairs in the room.

part1: What do you usually eat for dinner?
Do you cook at home? Why or why not?
How many meals do you eat every day?
Should people eat more vegetables? Why?
speaking.part2: Describe a meal you planned or cooked recently. You should say: what you made, who you cooked for, what ingredients you used, and why you chose that meal.
part3: Should schools teach students how to cook?
How can people eat healthy food when they are busy?
Do you think it is important to plan meals? Why?
What should people do to waste less food?

transfer.writing: Write a short message (5–8 sentences) to a friend about a meal you want to cook together. Use much, many, a little, a few, should, and should not. Say what ingredients you have, what you need, and what you should or should not do.
